newsitem.title: USA: Microlytics files to end SEC registration.
newsitem.headline: Microlytics files to end SEC registration.

text.p: Microlytics Inc said late Friday, after the market closed, that it has filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission to terminate its registration under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
The effect of such a termination, if granted, would be a cessation of its obligation to file quarterly and annual reports.

Termination would also limit future trading to the "Pink Sheets" and would cause the loss of certain rights of holders of restricted stock to resell those restricted shares under certain exemptions from the registration requirement of the Securities Act of 1933.
The company said that its shares had already been removed from the NASDAQ National Market for failure to meet "price" requirements and were now in fact only quoted in the Pink Sheets.
The company said the decision to deregister was motivated by the need to eliminate the substantial legal and accounting expense associated with filing the SEC reports.
